'''Foongy''' (Japanese: '''ダケちゃん''' ''Dake-chan'') is a {{p|Foongus}} that {{adv|Whitley}} owns in [[Pokémon Adventures]] and her [[List of characters' first Pokémon|first Pokémon]]. His [[Characteristic]] is that he is "impetuous and silly."

==History==
==={{MangaArc|Black & White}}===
[[File:Whitley and Foongy.png|thumb|200px|left|Foongy and Whitley]]
Prior to ''[[PS524|A Difficult Parting]]'', Foongy was one of the many Pokémon [[Team Plasma]] had liberated from people and planned to {{pkmn2|Released|release}} into the wild after {{adv|N}}'s victory. When she was a {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}, {{adv|Whitley}} was presented with a group of liberated Pokémon, only to notice a {{i|Poké Ball}} among the group. Believing [[Poké Ball]]s to be evil, Whitley attempted to remove the ball, only to discover that it was in fact a {{p|Foongus}}. Frightened, she threw the Foongus, only to apologize after discovering that he was actually a Pokémon. She then decided to give him the nickname Foongy, but [[Rood]] advised her not to do so as she would become attached to Foongy, making his eventual release into the wild a harder experience.

After Team Plasma was defeated, Whitley, {{OBP|Mom|Black 2 and White 2|her mother}}, and several other {{tc|Team Plasma Grunt}}s attempted to escape arrest by leaving [[N's Castle]]. Not wanting to leave N's friends behind, Whitley wanted to take the Pokémon with her, but her mother refused. After being allowed to pick the Pokémon she was closest towards by [[Anthea and Concordia]], Whitley decided to take Foongy with her. Afterward Whitley and the others all made their escape from N's Castle. 

==={{MangaArc|Black 2 & White 2}}===
[[File:Whitley Foongus Girl.png|thumb|150px|left|Foongy in the Pokéstar Studios]]
[[PS525|Two years later]], Whitley is enrolled into the [[Aspertia City]] [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]] by her mother. After arriving in class Whitley introduces herself and Foongy to her class. Later, {{adv|Cheren}} has the students compete in a tournament battle with one side for the boys and the other for the girls. Together, Whitley and Foongy eventually win their side of the tournament, much to Whitley's annoyance as she wanted to avoid standing out. As a reward for winning, Whitley is given a [[Pokédex]].
[[File:Foongy Original Trainer.png|thumb|200px|right|Foongy's original Trainer]]
In ''[[PS529|Pokédex Lecture]]'', Whitley and {{adv|Blake}} head to [[Pledge Grove]] to collect data for their Pokédexes. After Blake attempts to get too close to Whitley, Foongy quickly attacks with {{m|Sweet Scent}} to force Blake away. The Sweet Scent then attracts a wild [[Kelden|Keldeo]], which swiftly attacks the two Trainers, causing them to fall off a cliff. Blake manages to keep Whitley from falling, but was unable to do the same for Foongy. Whitley refuses to leave without the Mushroom Pokémon, and Blake goes down to save him. Reassuring Foongy that he does not want to cause harm to Whitley, Foongy allows Blake to help.

In ''[[PS530|Movie Panic]]'', Foongy was Whitley's partner in the movie Foongus Girl at [[Pokéstar Studios]]. Despite the lines being scripted, Foongy participates in a real battle against [[Brycen-Man Series|Brycen-Man]]'s {{p|Pawniard}}, taking it out with a {{m|Giga Drain}}. Before the battle could continue, a [[Big Monster Series|Mecha]] {{p|Tyranitar}} appeared and began attacking everyone in sight. Blake, in the guise of {{p|Dewott}} Kid, stepped in to rescue Whitley while his {{TP|Blake|Dewott}} defeated the Mecha Tyranitar. 

In ''[[PS536|Cold Storage Battle]]'', Foongy battled several Team Plasma Grunts' {{p|Muk}}, alongside [[Roxie]]'s {{p|Whirlipede}}, at the [[Castelia Sewers]]. Foongy easily defeated the group of Sludge Pokémon with a single {{m|Clear Smog}}, while also removing their stat changes from {{m|Acid Armor}}.

In ''[[PS547|The Final Battle]]'', Foongy went with [[Hugh]] to help him against two Team Plasma Grunts. Hugh and Foongy later met back up with Whitley, and Foongy used his spores to help N heal from injuries inflicted by [[Ghetsis]].

In ''[[PS548|Epilogue]]'', Whitley and N attempted to return Foongy to his original Trainer. To Whitley's relief, the Trainer turned down the offer and allowed Whitley to keep Foongy.

==={{MangaArc|X & Y}}===
Foongy appeared alongside Whitley and her team in ''[[PS595|Magearna Moves]]'', having successfully earned {{TP|Whitley|Delphox}}'s trust after a lot of hard work.

==Personality and characteristics==
Foongy is very protective of {{adv|Whitley}}, quickly stepping in to help her when trouble comes up. Foongy is a powerful battler, easily winning the [[Aspertia City]] [[Pokémon academy|Trainers' School]] tournament despite Whitley trying to lose. {{adv|Blake}} was also impressed by Foongy's strength, making sure to be alert when around the Mushroom Pokémon. Foongy tends to release spores that can put people to sleep when frightened, and he can use his spores as anesthesia.
